items.summary: CFO recommendation: reject both new product proposals and freeze new discretionary spend or admissions this cycle. Delivery is saturated at 10/10 slots, 39 improvements await measurement, 21 requests failed, and only 6 outcomes are proven. Revenue claims are unsupported: Amazon data covers 2026-09-21 only, with 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission under tracking_id=other; site-attributed income is $0 and cannot support site revenue, ROI, payback, or causal-lift claims. Contribution margin is not calculable because direct infrastructure, labor, and other costs are absent, and the $4.92 cannot be assigned to sites. AI spend is $2.2785467 on 2026-10-01 across only 4 of 38 expected sites; infrastructure spend and monthly budget limits are blank, so total budget exposure is unknown. Cost-to-learn is also not calculable because experiment-level spend is not linked to incremental outcomes. Preserve only existing canonical work after capacity clears, with financial acceptance based on measured site-attributed commission less direct change cost—not forecast revenue. Minimum measurement: dated site/content identifiers, provider tracking IDs, ordered and shipped items, commission, direct change cost, AI cost, infrastructure cost, and pre/post or treatment-control outcome linkage. Classify unavailable fields as unknown.

CFO handoff: retain the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA request only after the saveusfarms.com repair case is completed or justifiably closed, one slot is released, and site-overlap clearance is recorded. Preserve the 2026-09-21 baseline of 61 affiliate clicks, 0 ordered items, and $0 site-attributed commission. Measure post-change clicks, orders, shipped items, commission, and direct change cost for 14 days or 100 relevant new impressions/clicks. If site-level orders or commission remain unavailable, report the financial result as unknown.
